meta.title: About
meta.description: Engineering company in Varna, Bulgaria, working on the software, process and laboratory engineering between the plant floor and IT.

sections.title: The company
paragraphs: Imbra is an engineering company in Varna, Bulgaria, working with clients across Europe. It builds, tests, integrates and supports the software between the plant floor and IT — protocol stacks, data flows, historians and legacy systems — and the process and laboratory engineering that measures what the plant is doing.

The work is done by the two founders. One covers OT/IT and industrial software; the other covers process engineering, analysers and the laboratory. Both ends of the plant are held by the same small team, so there is no hand-off between process, automation and IT — and the engineer you speak to is the engineer who delivers.

sections.title: The people
paragraphs: Imbra is run by its two founders — one covering OT/IT and industrial software, the other process engineering, analysers and the laboratory. Their backgrounds, the disciplines they cover and their published research are on the team page.
